hook: Your blood delivery can arrive by drone.
title: Drones Drop Blood by Parachute in Rwanda
description:
In Rwanda, Zipline drones fly medical supplies, including blood, to health facilities. The drone does not land: it drops the package by parachute. Part of the series Tech That Sounds Fake.

#Shorts #Technology #Drones
comment_prompt: Would you trust drone delivery? Yes or no
